thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Receives a Hold from Wells Fargo

author: Austin Angelo
title: Apple (AAPL) Receives a Hold from Wells Fargo
text:
Austin Angelo - January 3, 2019, 4:11 AM EDT SHARE ON:
In a report released yesterday, Aaron Rakers from Wells Fargo maintained a Hold rating on Apple ( AAPL ). The company’s shares closed yesterday at $157.92, close to its 52-week low of $146.59.
According to TipRanks.com , Rakers is a 5-star analyst with an average return of 12.4% and a 57.6% success rate. Rakers covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Applied Materials Inc, Pure Storage Inc, and Western Digital.
Apple has an analyst consensus of Moderate Buy, with a price target consensus of $211.30, a 33.8% upside from current levels. In a report issued on December 20, Rosenblatt Securities also reiterated a Hold rating on the stock with a $165 price target.
.
The company has a one-year high of $233.47 and a one-year low of $146.59. Currently, Apple has an average volume of 41.8M.
